key_insight: Marformer directly predicts conditional marginals for missing variables from partial observations, enabling fast estimation of Bayes risk and value of information without modeling the full joint distribution.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical missing-data inference tool for decision systems, especially when rapid one-pass predictions are needed under incomplete information.
method: Transformer encodes each target distribution p(X_i) as a hidden vector.
Iteratively refines distribution representations via attention to other variables’ distributions.
Trains directly on conditional marginals, avoiding full generative modeling and domain-specific assumptions.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on Bayesian networks, discretized multivariate Gaussians, structured annotation data, and a real annotation dataset, where it matched or outperformed strong baselines and was substantially faster.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the training distribution and synthetic-style setup, so generalization to highly shifted real-world missingness patterns should be validated carefully.
paper_title: Marformer: A Transformer for Predicting Missing Data Distributions
